negative_reviews.author: Ed Smith
negative_reviews.text:
Excellent food, nice drink and polite staff

Soured at the end by a hidden service charge that was not mentioned. Scummy behaviour and sharp practice.

negative_reviews.author: Sarah Cook
negative_reviews.text:
Just been here for our first time. Had the squid which still had the membrane attached, when I mentioned this I was informed that the food all comes in prepared and all they do is fry/heat it up. For a £90 bill for 2 people I expected it to be freshly prepared. I have had better food from the supermarket.

Currently sat feeling nauseous and unwell. Would recommend staying away!
